DML.SELECT: SELECT alarm_config_id as "alarmConfigId", element_type_id as "elementTypeId", param_type_id as "paramTypeId", element_type_param_id as "elementTypeParamId", alarm_threshold_operation_id as "alarmMeasureOperationId", threshold_val1 as "thresholdVal1", threshold_val2 as "thresholdVal2" FROM conf.alarm_config_measures
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.alarm_config_measures (alarm_config_id, element_type_id, param_type_id, element_type_param_id, alarm_threshold_operation_id, threshold_val1, threshold_val2, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:alarmConfigId, :elementTypeId, :paramTypeId, :elementTypeParamId, :alarmMeasureOperationId, :thresholdVal1, :thresholdVal2, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM conf.alarm_config_measures WHERE alarm_config_id = :alarmConfigId AND element_type_id = :elementTypeId AND param_type_id = :paramTypeId AND element_type_param_id = :elementTypeParamId
